subject: Onramp alignment: POC day-zero scheduling & owners
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Patel <alex.patel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Onramp alignment: POC day-zero scheduling & owners

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We want to lock in the POC "day-zero" onramp meeting where we cover success criteria, timeline, and owners (AE + SE + your engineering, procurement, and security reps). Proposed agenda attached.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm 2-hour windows next week that work for your team? We prefer an early window (09:00–11:00 PT) or late afternoon (15:00–17:00 PT).
- Please loop in procurement and security contacts so we can cover contract/controls questions in the same call.

High-level success criteria we aim to agree on in the session:
1) Technical integration feasibility: checklist for network/keys and sample dataset access.
2) Procurement milestones: decision owner and timeline for PO/terms.
3) Security gating: required docs and evidence (SOC2, data residency).
4) Shared acceptance criteria for the POC (response latency, throughput target, and sample prompt set).

I copied Dylan (SE) to lead the technical walkthrough and Soojin (solutions) to run through success metrics. Marissa (CS lead) will coordinate follow-ups.

Attached: POC_onramp_draft_agenda_20250615.xlsx

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Patel <alex.patel@atlashealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Onramp alignment: POC day-zero scheduling & owners

Hi Rachel —

Thanks, this is helpful. I can confirm our engineering lead (Maya Singh) and procurement (procurement@atlashealth.com) are available next week. A few notes up front:
- Procurement prefers a separate 30m contract check but is fine joining the first 30m of the onramp.
- Security asked us to provide the security questionnaire PDF in advance; I attached a placeholder (will follow with the completed QA).

Availability from our side:
- Tue 2025-06-17: 09:00–11:00 PT (preferred)
- Wed 2025-06-18: 15:00–17:00 PT (backup)

If Tue 09:00 works for you and Dylan, we can put a calendar hold and I will add Maya + procurement + security.

Best,
Alex

AtlasHealth

Date: 2025-06-15T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp alignment: POC day-zero scheduling & owners

Alex —

Tue 06/17 09:00–11:00 PT works for us. Locking it: we'll send a calendar invite once Dylan confirms a final SE attendee/time slice.

A couple of prep items so the meeting is high-value:
- Dylan: can you bring the short integration runbook (network ports, sample curl + auth)? Target = 15m walkthrough.
- Soojin: please prepare the acceptance criteria doc (we'll share the sample prompt set + latency/throughput targets).
- Marissa: please add a follow-up milestone column to the attached agenda so procurement/security actions are assigned.

Alex: if procurement wants a separate 30m, suggest we keep the first 30m focused on business owners and contract checklist, then hand to procurement/security for the last 30m — that way engineering can stay for the whole session. Open to adjustments.

Attaching the draft agenda again.

Thanks —
Rachel

From: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Alex Patel <alex.patel@atlashealth.com>

Date: 2025-06-16T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp alignment: POC day-zero scheduling & owners

Hi all —

We prefer a dedicated 30-minute procurement sync after the technical walkthrough to avoid scope creep. Proposed flow:
- 09:00–09:30 PT: Business + quick intro (Rachel, Alex, Maya)
- 09:30–10:30 PT: Technical walkthrough & integration runbook (Dylan)
- 10:30–11:00 PT: Procurement + security checklist (procurement@atlashealth.com, security@atlashealth.com)

Action items for Redwood before the call:
- Provide the standard MSA + Data Processing Addendum (DPA) draft or a link to your redlines.
- Share the minimal network/egress IP list (so security can validate firewall rules).

We can accept a 09:00 start on Tue 2025-06-17. I will send a calendar invite and include a DocuSign placeholder for the MSA.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
AtlasHealth

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Onramp alignment: POC day-zero scheduling & owners

Morning team —

I'm good for Tue 06/17 09:00–11:00 PT and will lead the technical portion. Quick notes on what I'll present (to align expectations):
- 15m: Redwoods runtime overview + network/auth requirements (sample cURL + allowed IPs).
- 20m: Live demo: short inference flow with KV cache enabled (will use a sample prompt set).
- 15m: Integration checklist + developer onboarding doc links.
- 10m: Q&A + next steps (pointer to tickets/training).

Prep items I'm requesting from Atlas:
- Temporary sample data access (S3 URL or sanitized CSV) so I can run the live demo without production data.
- Confirmation of any egress filtering that would block our test calls.

I'll attach the minimal runbook to the calendar event. See you all shortly.

- Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: 2025-06-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp alignment: POC day-zero scheduling & owners — confirmed

Thanks everyone for a productive session today. Notes / outcomes: 
- Confirmed POC acceptance criteria: 95th pct latency under 800ms for 512-token prompts; throughput target 20 req/s sustained for sample set.
- Owners: Rachel (AE) for commercial follow-ups, Dylan (SE) for integration/runbook, Maya (Atlas) for engineering test data, Procurement for PO/terms, Security for controls sign-off.
- Milestones agreed:
  • 2025-06-19: Atlas to share sanitized sample data and firewall rules (Maya)
  • 2025-06-23: Redwood to deliver test endpoint and integration checklist (Dylan)
  • 2025-06-30: Procurement target for PO signature (Procurement Team)

Attachments from today's meeting: Atlas_Security_QA_0625.pdf, POC_onramp_draft_agenda_20250615.xlsx

Next steps: I'll open a shared Trello board for action tracking and send the DocuSign MSA placeholder to Procurement. If anyone sees something missing from the milestones above, flag it in reply.

Thanks —
Rachel
